description: Fill a PDF form on disk using FillWise AI. Works with AcroForm PDFs (real fields) and digital flat PDFs (no fields, values are drawn at computed positions). Scanned PDFs are not supported. Writes the filled PDF next to the original by default.

attachment_paths.description: Up to 4 source documents (jpeg, png, webp or pdf, up to 5 MB each) the AI reads data from. Not the form itself.

data.description: Source text the AI takes values from: any format (notes, JSON, a pasted profile). Up to 60000 characters. Required unless attachments are given.

output_path.description: Where to write the filled PDF. Default: <pdf_path without extension>.filled.pdf

pages.description: Pages to fill, e.g. "1, 3-6". Default: all pages.

pdf_path.description: Absolute path to the PDF form (up to 20 MB).

name: fill_pdf
title: Fill a PDF form
